adjudication.rationale: The diff in `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts` changes `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, which is a clear inversion of when `slug` is written to the organization row. Previously, when team billing was enabled, `slug` was not set on the organization and instead `requestedSlug` was stored in `metadata` (`...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { requestedSlug: slug })`). Now, with team billing enabled it sets both `slug` and `requestedSlug`, which can trigger a Prisma unique constraint error at creation time if the slug is already taken—an error path that is not shown as specially handled in this diff and would typically surface as a 500.
